messages.author: 0a9519eb1d6cba1b
messages.subject: Fit indices
parts:
Hi, Yves. Thanks for the great SEM software. Iavaan has become one primary tool for my SEM analyses.

I know Iavaan can generate an assortment of fit indices. Although each fit index has its own merit, sometimes GFI and AGFI are frequently reported in certain research publications. Last time I checked, Iavaan still did not generate GFI and AGFI. Would it be possible to include these indices in future releases?

Thanks.

messages.author: af82fa98896529e2
messages.subject: Re: Fit indices
parts:
Hi,

You may use the semTools package which contains the moreFitIndices function that provides supplemental fit indices in addition to popular fit indices.

Sunthud
